evidence: HRTEM images indicate no evidence of the change in the HfO2-Al2O3 layered structure for the sample annealed at 850°C, almost same as the as-deposited sample. But, a significant intermixing appeared and the stacked structure was broken after annealing at 950°C, as shown in Fig. 2b, which is in good agreement with the MEIS spectra of Fig. 1. In addition, the structural transition from amorphous to crystalline structure is generated locally.
